description: Figure 3 is a bar chart titled "Difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps." The horizontal axis represents different stages of cumulative post-processing optimizations applied to the transcripts, with bars arranged from left to right in ascending order of optimization steps applied. The vertical axis represents the difference in average word error rate (WER), scaled linearly, with tick marks indicating values from -0.02 to 0.06, in increments of 0.02. Each bar corresponds to a specific optimization step and is colored gray; the bar heights represent the magnitude of the WER difference relative to the baseline Whisper large-v3 model. The first bar, representing the initial state with no optimizations applied, shows the largest negative difference, approximately -0.05. Subsequent bars show progressively smaller negative differences, indicating performance improvement, with the final bar representing the cumulative effect of all optimizations applied, which shows a difference of approximately 0.02. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the applied optimization steps. There are no visual elements such as shading, bolding, or annotations to emphasize any specific bar.
